texts.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
texts.en:
To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being weaponized.

The inhabitants have arrived at the bold idea of reversing the functionality of a replication unit so rather than assembling pre-programmed matter, the device can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

texts.zh: 我们与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享了我们的物质复制技术。它们本来应该用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但它们愚蠢地把它武器化了。它们反转了复制单元的功能，开始制造一个可以用来在原子水平上拆解生命体的装置。
texts.en: We shared our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. They were supposed to use it to reduce resource scarcity. But they're foolishly trying to weaponize it. By crudely reversing the functionality of a replication unit, they have started building a device which can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

label.zh: 没收这项技术，不能相信它们会正确使用它。
label.en: Confiscate the tech. They cannot be trusted to use it correctly.

label.zh: 它们决定如何使用这项技术与我们无关。
label.en: What they choose to do with the tech is not our concern.

texts.zh:
我们的特工到达时，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]正好在完成它们的手持式原子分解器。我们的人明确告知，赠送物质复制装置不是为了让它们这样使用的。

不出所料，它们不愿意放弃这项技术。当地政府火冒三丈，将我们的没收称作侵略行为。
texts.en:
Our agents arrived just as the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] were finalizing their hand-held atomic disintegrator. They were told in no uncertain terms that this was not the intended use for the matter replication unit we gifted them.

As expected, they were reluctant to part with the technology. Tempers flared, and the local government has labeled the confiscation an aggressive act.

texts.zh:
通过对我们的物质复制技术进行逆向工程，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]成功地制造了一个手持式原子分解器，并利用它大肆摧毁[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]。

在启动进一步的贸易协议之前，我们最好记住它们的毁灭倾向。
texts.en:
By reverse engineering our matter replication technology, the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] have successfully built a hand-held atomic disintegrator, and are using it to wreak havoc upon [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName].

We'd do well to remember their destructive tendencies before initiating further trade deals.
